canonical_name: Global Langlands reciprocity for GL_n over number fields
canonical_statement: Conjecturally, suitably geometric continuous semisimple n-dimensional l-adic representations of the absolute Galois group of a number field and suitably algebraic cuspidal automorphic representations of GL_n over its adeles correspond, with matching unramified Frobenius and Hecke characteristic polynomials and the prescribed local-global compatibilities.
domain_and_universes: K a number field; n >= 1; a rational prime l; finite l-adic coefficient field E; exact universes and embeddings remain open
quantifiers: for every n : Nat with 1 <= n
for appropriate l-adic Galois and algebraic cuspidal automorphic objects
hypotheses: Galois representations are continuous, semisimple, and satisfy the eventual source-audited geometric and ramification conditions
automorphic representations are cuspidal and satisfy the eventual source-audited algebraicity conditions
conclusion: A source-accurately normalized correspondence exists and matches Frobenius/Hecke data and required local factors.

alternate_encodings.relationship: may be required instead of a single l-adic representation

alternate_encodings.target: two directional existence theorems rather than a bijection
alternate_encodings.relationship: likely the mathematically precise decomposition of the broad label

degenerate_cases: n = 1 is included only as the abelian boundary case; n = 0 is excluded. Function fields and arbitrary reductive groups are excluded.
